description: Opens the local HYROX/triathlon dashboard (127.0.0.1 only) in the browser: session report, trends, readiness with evidence, and an audit tab to relabel/exclude workouts and check claims. Returns the URL; the server stops after 30 idle minutes.

view.description: Tab to open first. Default 'session' (latest HYROX session report).

name: open_performance_dashboard
